name: Modular Components National
old_description: Modular Components National is a manufacturer of printed microwave circuit boards.
about:
Modular Components National was founded in 1981 in Forest Hill, Maryland. The company has operated from this location for over four decades, serving government and commercial RF customers.

The company manufactures printed microwave circuit boards, specializing in PTFE substrates and high-reliability, tight-tolerance circuitry for RF, microwave, and millimeter-wave applications. Its fabrication capabilities include single- and double-sided circuits (0.002″ to 0.250″ thick), metal-backed circuits with fusion bonding and post-fabrication attachment, and multilayer constructions using PTFE, mixed dielectrics, FR-4, and microwave laminates. Proprietary processes support embedded copper heat-sink cores, thermoclastic bond films such as FEP lamination, and laser routing for thin dielectrics with complex profiles. Materials sourced from Arlon, Rogers, and Taconic are used throughout.

MCN serves the defense, aerospace, telecommunications, and medical markets, as well as broader government and commercial RF sectors. Its sales representative network covers regions across the United States, Canada, and Israel.

The company emphasizes proprietary processes developed for demanding military and aerospace requirements and maintains AS9100D and ITAR certifications, stating it strives to operate above industry standards.
